2026 US Open accommodation analysis

Queens shows the clearest accommodation premium

Across both Airbnb and Booking.com, average Queens accommodation prices were roughly 22% to 27% higher during the Aug. 31–Sept. 13 window than for the same-length stay one month later.

Manhattan tells a less consistent story

Airbnb prices were also higher in Manhattan, while Booking.com averages were effectively flat. That split is why Queens is the cleaner location-level finding.

Key contrast: Manhattan Booking.com’s median price was 9.4% lower during the tournament-period window even though its average was essentially unchanged.

Methodology

Action Network analyzed 2,073 Airbnb and Booking.com search listings for Queens and Manhattan. The comparison uses two 13-night, two-adult stays: Aug. 31–Sept. 13, 2026 and Sept. 30–Oct. 13, 2026. Prices are shown in U.S. dollars; per-night values divide the 13-night total by 13. The listing pool can differ between search windows, so the figures describe the observed price difference rather than attributing every change solely to the tournament.
